name: Kamogawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kamogawa city emblem in blue, orange and red: a blue stylised wave with an orange bird's head and red beak.
history: Municipal flag of Kamogawa, a city in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 17 June 2005.

features.role: Kamogawa city emblem — a blue stylised wave with an orange bird's head and red beak
